title: Leveraging Knowledge Graphs and LLMs for Structured Generation of Misinformation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the baseline tendency of LLM-based fact-checkers (e.g., Falcon-40b) to label inputs as fake regardless of their actual truthfulness, measured by comparing classification accuracy on datasets of both generated fake facts and ground-truth real facts.

Analyzing the variance in LLM detection accuracy across 25 distinct knowledge graph semantic categories (e.g., sports, travel, architecture) to identify topic-level vulnerabilities and variations in model judgment.
